question: What page-descriptor fields are required by the native activity manager, and which lifecycle fields remain unresolved?
prototype_hypothesis: firmware_page_descriptor begins with a mutable activity-manager header of at least 76 bytes; built-in app-specific descriptor extensions contain lifecycle callbacks beyond that header
callsite_evidence: app_install sub_CA519AC indexes each supplied page using the pointer at page+16 before storing the page pointer for the app lifetime
activitymanager_page_register sub_CA523B0 requires page+16 name and nonzero page+20 numeric ID, rejects duplicate +20 IDs, and mutates the descriptor in place
Flashlight page at 0x200D03D8 has name 'main' at +16, composite page key {u16 page_id=0 at +20, u16 app_id=26 at +22}, and occupies 116 bytes before alignment
Flashlight lifecycle extension contains on_create at +76, on_resume at +80, on_pause at +88, on_destroy at +92, and optional on_ui_destroy at +96 based on wrapper dispatch and callback decompilation
quickapp allocates exactly 116 bytes for a page descriptor and initializes callbacks through +108
control_flow_evidence: registration rejects a zero 32-bit composite key at +20 and detects duplicates using the same {page_id, app_id} word
registration defaults bytes +40/+41 to 4 and +42 to 2
registration writes scheduling fields +28=INT_MAX, +32=INT_MAX, +36=0 and clears page flags +24 bit6
registration defaults pointers +0, +44, +56, +72 and links the page through intrusive pointers +64/+68
registration walks the +0 parent/default chain until it finds a non-null callback at +52 and invokes it
on_create wrapper allocates the root object into page+48 and invokes callback +76 as (page, root, start_data); resume/pause/destroy wrappers invoke +80/+88/+92 with the page pointer
page unregister at sub_CA52E5C unlinks +64/+68, drives pause/destroy as needed, and invokes the +52 signal callback with event 2
app_install stores page pointers without copying page descriptor bytes
ownership_analysis: Page descriptors must reside in writable storage owned for the full registration lifetime. app_install borrows their pointers; activitymanager_page_register mutates their header and links them globally. The app module therefore cannot unload until an unregister function has removed every page and all callbacks are drained.
unsafe_assumptions: the meanings of callbacks at +84 and +100/+104/+108 remain only partially recovered
the +52 signal callback event vocabulary is only partially recovered despite observed register/resume/pause/destroy dispatch
page navigation accepts the composite u32 key at +20, but animation argument structures and UI-owner dispatch requirements still need a device probe
recommended_probe: Build a resident-only synthetic page with a permanent 116-byte writable descriptor, register it through app_install, add its u16 app_id to Launcher, and render one system LVX list row from on_create. Never unload the probe module; exercise open/resume/pause/destroy on device before enabling production registration.
